brief:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee faced criticism Tuesday after appearing to distinguish between Israelis and Palestinians in remarks about elections, according to Middle East Eye. The comments implied that Palestinian citizens of Israel were not considered Israeli, drawing rebukes over the characterization.

Details of Huckabee's specific statements and the identities of those who criticized him were not immediately available.
dek: Mike Huckabee criticised for distinguishing between Israelis and 'Arabs' in elections US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee faced criticism on Tuesday after he appeared to imply Palestinian citizens of Israel were not Israeli.
title: Huckabee draws fire for separating Israelis from Arabs in election remarks
